campaign.title: Classify the residual nonsquare reciprocal resonances

resource_policy.literature_policy: Primary-source searches may be used for radical spacing, determinant/incidence, or large-sieve comparisons, but no theorem is imported without an exact variable, range, weight, and endpoint map.

frozen_target.question: After removing the proved primitive-square family, does high multiplicity in the complete actual-symbol reciprocal-resonance set force a further explicit algebraic structure, or can one prove a quantitative generic incidence estimate strong enough to feed the next signed-energy round?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For primitive odd coprime a<b<4a with ab nonsquare, delta=sqrt(b)-sqrt(a), Lambda=X delta^2/2, J delta/(2sqrt(a))<k<J delta/sqrt(b), and G asymp L/b, classify ||Lambda/k|| <= 1/R for dyadic 1<=R<=N_{a,b}<=G while retaining the complete Round-77 coefficient.
quantities: The exact residual set excludes only ab square, equivalently the graph-accepted primitive-square/common-squarefree family.
The metric window is equivalent to an integer ell satisfying |Lambda-ell k|<=k/R; exact divisibility is only one special case.
A useful inverse theorem must be quantitative on dyadic a, b-a, k, G, and R blocks and must state how its output can enter a signed primitive-ray energy estimate.
An incidence count alone is not the final M2 estimate and may not take absolute values over the full primitive-ray union.
scope: complete Round-77 centred-integral coefficient and lift support
separation from the later signed-energy estimate

completion_criteria: Derive the exact dyadic Abel-to-metric-window and nearest-integer formulation with all ranges and parities.
Prove a quantitative inverse/incidence theorem for nonsquare rays, or give a rigorous actual-range no-go/counterfamily showing the proposed inverse principle is false or too weak.
Identify every structured enlargement forced by high multiplicity and separate it from the already closed square family.
Carry any proposed incidence bound through the accepted coefficient scale far enough to show exactly what the next signed-energy theorem would still require.
Test near-square, fourth/perfect-power, one-point k, metric-resonance, endpoint, and adversarial-coefficient controls.
Complete a clean statement-only rederivation, an analytic attack, and a hostile/source audit.
Do not promote the full signed cone, M9-M2, M9, endpoint uniformity, or the exponent unless the exact signed energy is unexpectedly proved.
